adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the code enters the else branch and tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId`. But externalCalendarId is undefined at this point, so this find() will never match any calendar (unless a calendar has externalId === undefined, which is unlikely). This means selectedCalendar will be undefined when externalCalendarId is not provided, instead of falling back to the destination calendar. This is a clear logic bug - the find condition should use a different criteria (like credentialId) when externalCalendarId is absent.
